description: Phase 1 demo question set (12 cases). 8 answerable, 2 role-denied (employee asking roster/compensation data, which is manager-and-above only), 2 out-of-corpus. expected_fact values are exact substrings of the named source document, verified to survive the offline local chunker. expected_fact_any lists every phrasing accepted for scoring (checked after run_demo normalization; each entry normalizes into some chunk of the expected source, verified in test_demo_set.py).
